entities.summary: Armenia is a sovereign nation in West Asia, Asia. Its capital is Yerevan. Official languages include Armenian. Government: Unitary parliamentary republic. Population: approximately 2.8 million. Area: 29,743 km². Comprehensive index for Armenia covering Urartu, Orontid dynasty, Artaxiad empire (Tigranes the Great), Arsacid Armenia and first Christian state (AD 301), Bagratid kingdom, Armenian renaissance, Seljuk/Mongol invasions, Safavid-Ottoman partition, Armenian Genocide 1915, First Republic 1918, Soviet Armenia, Nagorno-Karabakh conflict, independence 1991, and 2020/2023 Artsakh losses.
